MERGE INTO CASH_ART_DEAL TT USING ( SELECT #{seqno} SEQNO, #{portfolioId} PORTFOLIO_ID, #{acctId} ACCT_ID, #{adjDate,jdbcType=DATE} ADJ_DATE, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY, #{adjAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL} ADJ_AMT, #{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON ( TT.PORTFOLIO_ID = TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TT.ACCT_ID = TEMP.ACCT_ID AND TT.ADJ_DATE = TEMP.ADJ_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TT.ADJ_AMT = TEMP.ADJ_AMT,TT.CCY = TEMP.CCY, TT.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TT.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQNO, PORTFOLIO_ID, ACCT_ID, ADJ_DATE, CCY, ADJ_AMT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(TEMP.SEQNO, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.ACCT_ID, TEMP.ADJ_DATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.ADJ_AMT, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)

MERGE INTO PTL_CASH_POSITION_FLOW TT USING ( SELECT #{seqno} SEQNO, #{portfolioId} PORTFOLIO_ID, #{acctId} ACCT_ID, #{hodingType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} HODING_TYPE, #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} CDATE, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY, #{amount,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AMOUNT, #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER_ID, #{chlFinprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CHL_FINPROD_ID, #{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME, #{splitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SPLIT_TYPE FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON ( TT.PORTFOLIO_ID = TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TT.ACCT_ID = TEMP.ACCT_ID AND TT.CDATE = TEMP.CDATE AND TT.HODING_TYPE = TEMP.HODING_TYPE )
/** WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TT.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT,TT.HODING_TYPE = TEMP.HODING_TYPE,TT.CCY = TEMP.CCY,**/ WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TT.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT, TT.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TT.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQNO, PORTFOLIO_ID, ACCT_ID, HODING_TYPE, CDATE, CCY, AMOUNT, ORDER_ID, CHL_FINPROD_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, SPLIT_TYPE) VALUES(TEMP.SEQNO, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.ACCT_ID, TEMP.HODING_TYPE, TEMP.CDATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.AMOUNT, TEMP.ORDER_ID, TEMP.CHL_FINPROD_ID, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.SPLIT_TYPE)

MERGE INTO ETR_CASH_POSITION_FLOW TT USING ( SELECT #{seqno} SEQNO, #{portfolioId} PORTFOLIO_ID, #{acctId} ACCT_ID, #{hodingType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} HODING_TYPE, #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} CDATE, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CCY, #{amount,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AMOUNT, #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER_ID, #{chlFinprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CHL_FINPROD_ID, #{offsetFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OFFSET_FLAG, #{offsetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OFFSET_ID, #{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{createTime} CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser} UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) TEMP
ON ( TT.PORTFOLIO_ID = TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TT.ACCT_ID = TEMP.ACCT_ID AND TT.CDATE = TEMP.CDATE AND TT.HODING_TYPE = TEMP.HODING_TYPE )
/** WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TT.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT,TT.HODING_TYPE = TEMP.HODING_TYPE,TT.CCY = TEMP.CCY,**/ WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TT.AMOUNT = TEMP.AMOUNT, TT.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER,TT.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SEQNO, PORTFOLIO_ID, ACCT_ID, HODING_TYPE, CDATE, CCY, AMOUNT, ORDER_ID, CHL_FINPROD_ID, OFFSET_FLAG, OFFSET_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES(TEMP.SEQNO, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.ACCT_ID, TEMP.HODING_TYPE, TEMP.CDATE, TEMP.CCY, TEMP.AMOUNT, TEMP.ORDER_ID, TEMP.CHL_FINPROD_ID, TEMP.OFFSET_FLAG, TEMP.OFFSET_ID, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME)
